The overall market conditions remain challenging, and the best path forward is to continue preserving my capital and building my knowledge and pattern recognition skills to better identify and avoid these manipulative schemes in the future.

My goal is to gradually rebuild my capital and positioning in a disciplined manner, without falling victim to the ongoing manipulation attempts.
